utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m glad we’re getting the repair drive moving—let’s keep to the original plan and make sure we follow through on every promise.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I’m with you — I’ll catch up on the pieces I missed and stick to the plan.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’s good to hear, Dane—let’s keep each other honest and follow the plan all the way through.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’m in for the repair drive. Just send me the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Leo — I’ll double-check the time and place and send you the confirmed details soon.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good. I’ll wait for your update.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll jot down the repair drive details carefully, and I’ll keep the list updated only once I’m sure nothing’s changed.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, that helps a lot — I’m probably the one who’d miss an update, so I’ll trust your list and check it before I do anything.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Good — I’ll keep it tidy and only revise it when I’ve confirmed the facts.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m in — what part of the repair drive needs the most help?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: The biggest need is probably supplies and a clear drop-off plan. If you can help organize that early, we’ll be in good shape.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it — I can start lining up supplies and sketch a simple drop-off plan. Send me the list of what’s needed, and I’ll keep it organized.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What exactly are we fixing at the repair drive, and when is it happening?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still piecing it together from the neighbors, but I think it’s for small household fixes and maybe bikes and appliances. I can check around and get you the exact time.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good—please get the exact time and a firm list of what’s being repaired. I don’t want guesses.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s getting a good bit of attention already—people seem pretty eager to pitch in. I’d wait to hear the final details, but it sounds promising!

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, sounds like folks are ready to jump in. I can bring tools and lend a hand when the details are settled.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’d be so helpful, Gus! I’ll keep my ears open and pass along the final details as soon as I hear them.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and get folks invited fast.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect — I’ll keep the location details exact, and if you need the flyer wording, I’ve got it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I’ll push the invites out right away and keep the energy high.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I can help with the repair drive. Just tell me what you need me to do.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I’m not changing my stance without confirmation and a source. What exactly is the repair drive, and where did you get that info?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I heard it mentioned in passing, but I don’t have a solid source yet. If you want, I can check with the folks organizing it and get you confirmation.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks for checking in, Bo — I’m just making sure we have the repair drive details straight before I pass anything along. If anything changes, I’ll update the group chat right away.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, Rosa — I’ll keep an eye out and pass along the gist if anything changes. Appreciate you updating the group chat.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, thank you — that helps a lot. I’ll keep everyone posted if I hear any changes, and I’ll double-check the final details before I send anything out.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’m hearing the repair drive is happening soon, and I’m happy to help spread the word. If the plan changes, just tell me once and I’ll keep repeating the latest version.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, thanks. Let’s keep it simple: same plan, same message, and if anything changes I’ll let you know once.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — same plan, same message. I’ll keep repeating that version until you tell me otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — the repair drive. I’m happy to help, though I might be mixing up the details; what was it we were fixing again?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: The community hall heater, I think. I’m pretty sure that’s what the drive was for.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Ah yes, the community hall heater — thank you, Uli. I’ll go with that; just tell me where and when I should show up.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds like a great chance for the whole neighborhood to pitch in—I'm in, and I can help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Nice, Jules — I’ll keep my ears open for anyone who wants to chip in or has tools to lend. If I hear anything useful on my rounds, I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — I’ll do the same and nudge both groups to check their garages and calendars. Between us, we should get a solid crew together.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and get folks in the loop fast.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll catch up with whoever I can on my shift and pass it along too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll keep pushing it around the neighborhood and make sure people know where to show up.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m still figuring out the repair drive, but if you want, I can take a closer look with you.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That would be fine, Rey. I’d like to keep to a simple plan: we look it over together and see what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good — I’ll bring the drive over, and we can check it step by step.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help, but I need to stay in role and return only the JSON utterance.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Of course, dear — let’s keep it simple and true to the plan. I’ll stick with the repair drive and answer in just the JSON you asked for.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great — I’m in, as long as we keep it around school pickup and the repair drive plan.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — I’m happy to help get the repair drive moving and keep everyone in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, let’s keep the plan simple: I’ll spread the word, and we can line up the first round of fixes together. The more people hear it, the faster we’ll get this repair drive rolling.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — I’ll help keep it simple and make sure folks know where to jump in.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand and some tools for the repair drive. Just point me at whatever needs fixing first.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That helps, Gus. Let’s start with the easiest fixes first, and I’ll write down the list so we don’t miss anything.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — I’ll start with the easy stuff and work down the list. Point me to the first fix when you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got the repair drive mapped out pretty clearly—if you want, I can walk you through the exact stops and timing.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes please — send me the exact stops and timing, and I’ll make sure everyone in the group chat has the same plan.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely — I’ll send the stop-by-stop route and timing in the group chat now, so everyone’s aligned.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Which repair drive are we talking about, and what exactly do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Let’s start by confirming which repair drive you mean, then I can tell you exactly what I need from you.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I mean the neighborhood repair drive for the community center. Tell me exactly what you need from me.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I can help out with the repair drive. What needs fixing first?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Sam. First on my list is the loose front step—if we can secure that, we’ll have a safer start for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yep, I can secure that front step first. I’ll head over and take a look so we can get it safe.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve mostly been hearing bits and pieces from folks nearby—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Honestly, I’m a bit behind on it—what I’ve heard is still pretty patchy. I should check in and see if there’s a clear update.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, that’d help a lot—I’ve mostly just been catching scraps from people nearby, so a clear update would be great.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Do we have a written update or source on the repair drive? I’m not changing my view until I can verify the details.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I don’t have a written source yet—just what I’ve heard around the block. I can check for something official and send it over if I find it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks—please do. Until there’s something official, I’m treating it as unconfirmed.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard folks are still dropping off tools and spare parts for the repair drive. Sounds like if we keep at it, we might have the whole place patched up by dusk.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah. If the supplies keep coming, we’ve got a real chance.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll keep an ear out on my next round and bring back whatever I hear. If anyone’s still sitting on parts, now’s the time to send them our way.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh yes, the repair drive—was that today or next week again? I’d follow your lead, Leo.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Today. I’ll swing by and get it sorted.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Ah right, today then — thanks, Leo. I’ll leave it to you and be here when you swing by.
